about: Generated-folder marker mutants (wf10 GEN-SIDECAR). Each is killed by the package's seeded property TestMarkerHoldsOnlyItsFolder.

mutants.name: genmark-held-ignores-digest
mutants.rule: A marker holds only while its digest is its folder's: a marker copied into a hand-written folder, or a hand edit of a generated file, hides nothing.

mutants.name: genmark-digest-skips-content
mutants.rule: The digest covers each file's content.

mutants.name: genmark-digest-skips-names
mutants.rule: The digest covers each file's path, so a marker moved to a folder of the same contents under other names does not hold.
